title: My PhD Interview at Shahid Beheshti University
excerpt: My PhD interview at Shahid Beheshti University was friendly and easy. I wasn't accepted, but the professors were genuinely nice and the vibe was great.

blocks.text: When I was invited for the PhD interview at Shahid Beheshti, I was really happy and thought I had a good chance of getting accepted at this university.
Honestly, Shahid Beheshti was the first university in my life that I had a PhD interview for.
Well, I found the university and the faculty well and easily, it wasn't hard at all. When I entered they asked my name and registered my attendance.
By the way, remember whenever a form announces a time for attendance, go earlier and don't limit yourself to going exactly at that time.
1: Try to have a lot of copies (10) of the forms you have so you can give them to the professors there.
2: Show up on the interview day well-groomed and with a proper appearance.
3: Don't be stressed. There's really nothing special.

4: If your interview lasted less than 5 minutes or they didn't take your resume or anything from you at all, you were most likely Rejected, and them saying these don't have an effect is to not break your heart. Accept the reality.

When I entered the interview room, 8 or 9 of their professors were present. I introduced myself and explained the things I had done and the academic story of my life. I explained the papers I had worked on and the papers that were on my hands at that time, and they also asked me about the extra activities I had done.
The vibe was very friendly and they were very good too. I didn't feel any particular pressure at all and it really passed very easy and cool.
They didn't ask anything special in terms of technical questions either, but they asked me about the experiences I had in papers and these things.
My interview lasted about 30 minutes and they also took my resume and some of my documents.
In the end I wasn't accepted but it was a very very good interview, the vibe was very good and the professors were really kind and truly nice.
